pk.context: 40 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Absolute bioavailability is about 80%, and food does not affect absorption. About 80% is bound to plasma proteins, and biotransformation is mainly hepatic.
clues.substance: A hydrobromide salt that is a fine, white to off-white powder. The active moiety has a molecular weight of 324.4.
clues.product: Under an NDA, tablets of 10, 20 and 40 mg, dosed once daily.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for suicidal thoughts in young patients. Contraindicated with MAOIs within 14 days, with pimozide, and in hypersensitivity; ejaculatory delay in men is the most common reaction.
clues.indication: Treatment of major depressive disorder in adults.
clues.mechanism: Presumed to inhibit neuronal serotonin reuptake in the CNS, potentiating serotonergic activity.

tell: Its metabolites are at least eight times less potent than citalopram at blocking serotonin reuptake, so they likely add little.
